review.publication: Local only. No commit, push or deployment.
review.scope: Fishing purpose/method/location intersections, equipment and participant roles; animal-capable hunting, generic nets, fishing adjectives and a reviewed fishing duplicate.
review.attribution: Reviewed adaptations of Open English WordNet 2025 by the Open English WordNet Team, derived from Princeton WordNet; CC BY 4.0 and Princeton notices remain in docs/quality/2026-10-09-q11.md#sources-and-reuse. FAO, NOAA, FWS, Cambridge and Russian dictionaries support selected senses. Source definitions are not copied; scope and graph mappings are editorial adaptations.
review.context_policy: All new concepts and assertions use U1 and unspecified strength. Method, economic or recreational purpose, location, equipment and participant role are distinct axes. Human fishing is not a kind of the existing animal-capable hunting action, and neither category receives a blanket exclusion against the other.

sense_decisions.scope: Fishing for recreation, without requiring competition or a successful catch.
Fishing as commercial work. Select the activity, not the business organization itself.
Fishing to provide food for the household. This restricted purpose does not import every national subsistence-fishery category.
Angling using an artificial fly. Not every fly-fishing activity is recreational.
Angling with a line drawn through the water. Exclude online provocation and the mythical creature.
Hook-and-line fishing with the line handled directly. The method is distinct from its handline equipment.
Fishing using a net; not the manufacture of net fabric.
Fishing through an opening in ice. This setting does not by itself specify hooks, recreational purpose or safe ice conditions.
Fishing from the shore; neither a particular gear nor recreational purpose is required.
Fishing from a boat, regardless of the selected gear or purpose.
The intersection of recreational fishing and hook-and-line fishing.
The intersection of recreational purpose and fishing from shore.
Purpose-made fishing equipment, considered by equipment kind rather than as one mandatory assembled kit. Exclude bare rig and tackle homonyms.
Line made for fishing. Do not require a float, sinker, leader or braided-cord construction on every line.
A fishing line managed by hand; exclude the climbing handline sense.
A hook intended to catch fish. Correct the dictionary requirement that every fishhook have a barb.
A fishing hook without a projecting barb. No injury, survival or catch-rate guarantee is asserted.
A reel for managing fishing line. Exclude film reels, thread spools and dances.
A line-mounted float used in angling. Cork is not a required material.
A weight for keeping fishing gear lower in the water. No material is required; exclude baseball and food senses.
An artificial lure for attracting fish during angling. Do not require every lure to use the dictionary's combined material, brightness and feather description.
The artificial-fly lure used in angling, distinct from the living insect, garment opening and tent cover.
A net intended for fishing. Enclosure during hauling is not the mechanism of every subtype.
The handled net used to bring a fish out of the water.
A fishing net designed to retain fish in its mesh. Do not make hauling enclosure a universal requirement.
A fishing net designed for towing through water. Great depth is not required. Exclude the longline homonym.
A fishing rod intended for fly fishing. No material, fixed length or mandatory reel is asserted.
The restricted rod-equipped-with-reel case, distinct from all fishing rods.
A person whose work includes commercial fishing. Do not impose this employment restriction on every fisher.
A person fishing for recreation, not necessarily employed in fishing.
A person using hook-and-line fishing. Exclude the anglerfish and scheming-person senses; paid work is not required.
The same participant role combines recreational purpose with hook-and-line fishing.
The rare noun denotes the existing fishing activity. Rarity alone does not make a word invalid. The full removed source row, terms and genus edge are archived.
Hunter remains under worker pending review of recreational and occupational person roles.
General catching has several physical and figurative meanings; do not make all of them animal capture.
The generic Russian cord is not used as a universal fishing-line genus; monofilament and braided constructions need separate review.
Retain animal capabilities, the explicit non-predatory negation and other inherited rows. The old hunting/defence exclusion remains queued.
Inherited targets naming individual fish species remain unchanged; this batch adds no species-specific rule or percentage.

review.limits: No fishing regulations, permits, species eligibility, environmental-performance guarantees, ice-safety thresholds or operating instructions. Gear material, hook barbs, reels and catch success are not universal requirements. Animal predation, hunter occupation, general catching, bait-food meanings and inherited fish-species targets remain queued. The old hunting/defence exclusion needs separate contextual review. No application test suites.

exclusion_review.decision: Correct hunting and fishing genera and remove their unsupported mutual exclusion; add no blanket exclusions and preserve every explicit negation.

review.collision_decision: No exact normalized cross-language collision is accepted. Existing rod, net, hook, fisher, fishing and angling meanings are reused. The unconnected fishing duplicate is archived and merged; the attested rare noun is preserved.

refreshed_comparison.caveat: Normalized spelling candidates are not verified identities or missing-concept counts.

repairs.reason: The existing hunting action has many animal capability assertions. It is not necessarily a human social action; use physical action and leave narrower human-purpose senses for later review.
Human fishing is a physical action. Do not make it a subtype of the existing broad animal-capable hunting action. OEWN 2025: oewn-01143220-v.
Hunting and fishing categories have variable scopes and can overlap in fish-directed pursuit. Remove the unsupported blanket exclusion instead of forcing a universal biological or legal boundary.
This existing method is a narrower fishing activity; reuse it instead of creating a duplicate angling concept. OEWN 2025: oewn-00455261-n.
Refine the rod through the fishing-gear family, preserving its tool ancestry. OEWN 2025: oewn-03356825-n.
Refine the rod purpose to the hook-and-line method, which remains a kind of fishing. OEWN 2025: oewn-03356825-n.
Not every net is fishing gear. Assign the fishing purpose to the newly distinguished fishing-net subtype. OEWN 2025: oewn-03357474-n.
A fisher may fish as recreation or work. Keep the general person role and add the worker genus only to the commercial subtype. Source: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/fisherman
The fishing-related adjective is a property, not a natural object. Source: https://gramota.ru/meta/rybolovnyy
The fishery-related adjective is a property, not a natural object. Its use for fishers, fleets and gear does not select one object genus. Source: https://gramota.ru/meta/rybolovetskiy
